nodes.plm_action: Cutting watermelon, strawberries, and other fruits into bite-sized pieces
nodes.plm_caption:
In the video the shot starts with a shot of glass jars filled with fruits on a granite counter. Then a black machine can be seen while a person cutting fruits on the cutting board. In the end the person's set up the jars up and in the fridge for storage.
The camera shakes slightly throughout the entire video.

Lighting is bright but not harsh, providing good contrast between the fruits and the kitchen surfaces.

The camera is handheld but stable. At 1s there is a brief panning shot to a black appliance which is not seen for the rest of the video.

summary.brief: A woman cuts fruit, fills mason jars with the fruit and water, seals them, cleans her tools, and stores the jars in the refrigerator.
summary.detailed: The video opens with clear glass mason jars already placed on a granite countertop beside a black water dispenser. The woman's hands appear on a white cutting board as she rapidly slices pineapple, cucumber, melon, strawberries, lemons, limes, blackberries and other fruits, using a knife and a spoon. She squeezes the ends of lemon, lime and pineapple into the jars before adding the chopped pieces, then pours water from the dispenser into each jar and caps them with metal lids. Overlay text at the bottom of the screen lists the ingredient combinations for each jar. After all jars are filled and sealed, she washes the cutting board and knife in the sink, loads them into a dishwasher, and finally carries the filled jars to an open refrigerator where they are arranged on a shelf beside bottles of water.

action.detailed: Cut assorted fruit, squeeze citrus ends into the jars, add the fruit pieces, pour water over them, seal each jar with its lid, clean the cutting board and knife, and place the filled jars in the refrigerator.
action.actor: a woman (hands visible)

nodes.plm_caption:
A person prepares jars of fruit on a kitchen counter. The video was sped up. The video starts with jars that are already prepared. She then shows the items on the counter next to the jars she will use. The person makes the jars, starting with filling them with various fruits and then adds a liquid and more fruit. The video is sped up so it looks like it is moving very fast.
The video begins with many jars of fruit on a kitchen counter. They are already filled with fruit and have lids on them. The video ends with them lined up. The person is next to the counter, putting various fruit and vegetables in jars. The video is sped up, so the food prep looks like it's happening rapidly.
The kitchen has granite countertops. A large black appliance can be seen in the room. It appears to be a water dispenser. It has a digital display at the top. There is a white cutting board in front of the jars. Black knives and a spoon can be seen on the cutting board. There are various fruits and vegetables that can be seen on the counter, including pineapple, cucumbers, strawberries, lemons and limes. The woman wears a white t-shirt and is wearing a watch on her left wrist. She holds a jar with left hand and a knife with her right hand. Her nails are painted white. A spoon can be seen with her right hand. The text "MrsNaturallyEJHalo" is seen in the right corner.

summary.brief: A woman swiftly cuts fruit, adds it to mason jars, fills them with water and seals them to make fruit‑infused water.
summary.detailed: The video opens with several empty mason jars lined up on a granite countertop beside a water dispenser and assorted fresh fruit. Wearing a white T‑shirt, a watch on her left wrist, and white‑painted nails, the woman grabs a knife and rapidly chops pineapple, cucumber, cantaloupe, strawberries, lemons, limes and basil. She squeezes the saved citrus ends into the open jars, scoops melon flesh with a spoon, and drops all the cut pieces into the jars. After the fruit is in place, she pours water into each jar, puts the silver lids on, tightens them, and arranges the finished jars side‑by‑side on the counter. The entire process is shown in fast‑motion and ends with the jars ready for infusion.

action.detailed: Cut the fruit, squeeze the citrus ends, place the pieces into the jars, add water, seal each jar with its lid, and arrange the jars on the countertop.
action.actor: the woman in a white T‑shirt wearing a watch on her left wrist

nodes.plm_caption:
A person can be seen closing the tops of jars of fruit, and then proceeds to cut up different fruits before washing and drying them. They then place them into a glass bowl and place it on the counter. In the end, the person opens up a refrigerator and the fruits inside the jars can be seen. The video is set in a kitchen.
Several types of fruits are visible throughout the video, including blueberries, blackberries, strawberries, and watermelon, as well as cucumbers, lemons, limes, pineapples, and berries. The person's attire is not visible. Jars of fruit, a cutting board, a white paper towel, and a stainless steel kitchen sink are all visible in the video.
The video is in a kitchen and the action is being performed in front of a white cutting board. It is well lit and in focus.
Some text can be seen at the bottom of the video that is too blurry to read.

summary.brief: The presenter seals the fruit‑filled jars, adds water, chops more fruit, washes the tools, and stores the jars in the refrigerator.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a hand placing metal lids on partially‑filled glass jars while a text overlay lists each jar’s fruit and water contents. After the sealed jars are shown side‑by‑side on the granite countertop, a cutting board with a red bowl appears; the presenter uses a knife to cube cantaloupe, slice strawberries, blackberries and other fruit, and drops the pieces into the bowl. The knife and cutting board are then rinsed under running water, placed in the sink, loaded into a dishwasher and the machine is started. Finally, a finger presses a button on a nearby black appliance and the camera shows the sealed jars arranged on a refrigerator shelf with on‑screen text reminding viewers to keep the jars chilled.

action.brief: Seal and store fruit‑infused water jars
action.detailed: Close the lids on the filled jars, pour water into them, chop additional fruit into a bowl, wash the knife and cutting board, load them into the dishwasher, and place the sealed jars inside the refrigerator.
action.actor: the woman (hands visible)

nodes.plm_caption:
The video features several cut watermelons, lemons and limes, among other things on a kitchen counter, with a counter of water bottles on top of a water dispenser. A person is briefly seen in the background.
The camera pans from the top to the bottom of a counter, showing several mason jars filled with cut fruit and herbs (three, actually.). The view then changes to show a cutting board, with a half a cantaloupe, three limes, three lemons, three strawberries and three packets of leaves. Next, the view changes to the front of a Whirlpool water dispenser, with water bottles on top, and a silver lid. There's a long view and a zoomed in view of the dispenser's buttons and water jug, showing numbers and letters displayed on the lid. The video cuts from the dispenser to a room's dining room area.

summary.brief: Mason jars filled with sliced fruit and herbs are shown, followed by a cutting board of assorted fruit, then the camera focuses on a Whirlpool water dispenser and a nearby refrigerator display.
summary.detailed: The camera pans down a kitchen counter, first revealing three clear mason jars that contain sliced fruit and fresh herbs. It then shifts to a white cutting board where a halved cantaloupe sits beside three limes, three lemons, three strawberries and three packets of leafy herbs. The view moves to the front of a black Whirlpool water dispenser, showing a large clear water bottle with a silver lid, illuminated control buttons and a digital read‑out of numbers and letters; a hand briefly points to the dispenser while a voice speaks. The shot pans left‑to‑right across the dispenser, then cuts to a nearby dining‑room area and finally to a Whirlpool refrigerator screen that displays the time and a temperature reading of 42 °F along with rows of control buttons.

action.detailed: Point at the water dispenser while speaking, then pan the camera to reveal its control panel, the surrounding dining area, and the nearby refrigerator screen.
action.actor: a woman in the background (the video host)

nodes.plm_action: Cut up melon and strawberries into squares and circles
nodes.plm_caption:
A person prepares fruit to be canned. They make the first can while cutting and preparing the fruit, then they add the remaining fruit to other empty cans to finish making the canning jars. The fruit preparation includes cutting up watermelon, strawberries, lemons, raspberries, cucumber, and pineapple.
The person first slices the watermelon and scoops out the seeds with a melon baller, then slices the melon and uses a spoon to remove the seeds. Next, they chop up the strawberries, while using a knife to chop up the raspberries, lemons, and cucumbers, and finally, they use the knife to cut up the pineapple.
The person is preparing the fruits to be canned, they cut up the watermelon and other fruits, and put them into the jar. Then they add basil into the jar and put the lid on top.
In the end, the person puts away the jars.

summary.brief: A woman chops a variety of fruits, fills mason jars with the pieces, adds basil and citrus, pours water into the jars and seals them.
summary.detailed: The video shows a woman working at a bright kitchen counter with a granite surface. She removes lids from several clear mason jars, then cuts a melon in half, scoops out the seeds and slices the flesh into bite‑size pieces. She continues slicing pineapple, cucumber, strawberries, lemons, limes and other fruit, placing the cut pieces into the open jars. She squeezes the saved ends of the lemon and lime into the jars, adds fresh basil leaves, and then pours filtered water over the fruit. After the water is added she secures each lid, lines the finished jars on the countertop and stores them away.

action.detailed: Cut the assorted fruits, put the pieces into mason jars, squeeze the saved lemon and lime ends into the jars, add basil leaves, pour water over the fruit, seal each jar, and arrange them on the countertop.
action.actor: A woman wearing a white top, with visible hands and a watch

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features jars of fruit being filled and labelled at the beginning, then at the end, jars are shown on a counter and labeled again.
This video is well lit, showing jars filled with water and fruit. There is text displayed on a black bar on the bottom of the screen.
There are six jars at the beginning, shown filled. Then, the video cuts to shot of 8 jars, lined up on a counter with text about which ingredients are in which jar displayed over the bottom of the video.
The beginning of the video shows a person placing a metal jar lid on a partially filled jar, before moving on to the end of the video shot of the counter showing jars full of water and fruit.

summary.brief: Fruit‑infused water jars are shown with their ingredients labeled.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a hand reaching for a metal jar lid and screwing it onto a partially filled glass jar on a granite countertop. The camera then pans across a row of clear jars, each filled with water and a colorful mix of sliced fruits and herbs such as strawberries, pineapple, cucumber, mint, lemon, lime, basil, blackberries and apples. A scrolling black banner at the bottom of the screen lists the contents of each jar. The jars are displayed side‑by‑side against a bright window, and a later shot adds a cutting board with additional cut fruit and a background view of chairs and a table.

action.detailed: Place the metal screw‑top onto the partially filled jar and tighten it before the camera moves to show the finished, labeled jars.
action.actor: the presenter’s hand

nodes.plm_action: Cut watermelon into cubes and add to bowl.
nodes.plm_caption:
In the video a woman demonstrates how to make a healthy drink. The drink is made by placing fruits in jars. The fruits include apples, blueberries, pineapple and lemon, and the jars are left on a fridge shelf.
The video is well lit and shot close up to the ingredients. Her knife is clean and sharp and her movements are smooth. The fridge and jars are clean and visible when the juice is made and the finished jars are left open, so the final results can be seen clearly.

summary.brief: A woman chops assorted fruit, fills mason jars with the pieces and water, washes her tools, and stores the jars in the refrigerator.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with the woman's hands on a white cutting board, where she cubes cantaloupe, slices strawberries, pineapple and lemon, and chops blackberries, blueberries, apple and other fruit, placing the pieces into a red bowl. She then transfers the cut fruit into several clear mason jars that sit on the granite countertop, squeezes lemon juice over some of them and tops the jars with water. After the jars are filled, she rinses the knife and cutting board under running water, loads them into a dishwasher, closes the dishwasher door, and the final shots show an open refrigerator with the sealed fruit‑infused water jars arranged on a shelf, accompanied by on‑screen text reminding viewers to keep the jars chilled.

action.detailed: Cut assorted fruit, place the pieces into a bowl and then into mason jars, add water and lemon juice, rinse the knife and cutting board, load them into the dishwasher, and store the sealed jars on a refrigerator shelf.
action.actor: a woman (visible from the arms down)

nodes.plm_caption: The video shows the supplies used for making a fruit infused water. The video begins with a shot of several jars of different fruits, including lemons, limes and raspberries. Below the jars there are the words "fruit infused water" in red letters. The video then changes to a shot of several different fruits, including pineapples, limes and raspberries, placed on a cutting board on a table. In the background there are empty jars lined up. To the right of the fruits, there is a melon and a bowl of raspberries. A voice can be heard at the end of the video talking about the importance of healthy fruit choices and the benefits of making your own fruit infused water at home. The video ends with the closing credits shown on the screen.

summary.brief: Colorful fruit‑filled jars and assorted fresh produce are displayed on a granite countertop with red title overlays.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with six clear mason jars lined up on a speckled granite surface, each jar holding a bright mix of fruit such as watermelon, lemon, lime, strawberry, blueberry, raspberry, blackberry and pineapple, while red text reading “Fruit Infused Water” overlays the image. The view then shifts to a cutting board on the same counter that holds pineapple wedges, limes, raspberries, a melon and a bowl of raspberries, with empty jars arranged in the background. The camera pans left and right, revealing additional fresh items – a cantaloupe, cucumber, strawberries, whole pineapple, small orange, grapefruit, zucchini and more limes – as well as stacks of empty jars, water packs, and a white cutting board. Toward the end a close‑up shows the countertop’s black‑granite finish, the assortment of fruits and vegetables, and five clear containers with metal lids alongside two larger glass jars. A red “Mrs Naturally EJ Halo” label appears in the lower‑right corner, followed by the closing credits.

action.detailed: N/A
action.actor: N/A

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a stationary still shot of a water cooler in a kitchen, with various food items lying on a marble table beside it. The shot pans from left to right. The video is a close up shot. The water cooler is in a hallway. The water cooler has a black and chrome base. The top is a plastic clear 5-gallon water bottle. The lid has condensation on the top of it.

summary.brief: A woman points to a Whirlpool water dispenser while the camera pans across it and the nearby doorway, then the view shifts to a close‑up of a Whirlpool digital display.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a close‑up of a black Whirlpool water dispenser on a marble countertop, a clear 5‑gallon bottle with condensation on its lid and illuminated red and white buttons. A woman’s hand appears, pointing at the controls as she explains the dispenser, and the camera pans left to reveal a red‑walled hallway, a white door and a wooden chair; the door is then closed. The shot then shows the dispenser beside the doorway with its large clear water container filled, followed by a close‑up of a Whirlpool appliance’s digital screen displaying temperature readings such as 42° and several button icons, with a brief zoom in and out.

action.detailed: Point to the water dispenser, describe its buttons while the camera pans across the appliance and surrounding doorway, then focus on the digital display of the nearby Whirlpool appliance.
action.actor: A woman

nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a woman preparing several fruits and veggies for a meal. The woman starts by cutting a pineapple into thin slices. She then moves on to cut up cucumbers and an off-white melon, followed by strawberries and lemon. She also places cut-up blackberries on a separate plate. Additionally, there are several jars on the counter, and the woman prepares to start cutting the melon inside them. It is unclear whether she does cut up the watermelon since she is working on the melon instead.
The kitchen features granite countertops with darker and lighter specks. There is a power socket built into the counter, and a chair is visible to the right. The room has a window to the left of the person, and there is a microwave in the left side of the frame.

summary.brief: A woman cuts assorted fruits and fills several glass jars on the countertop.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with the woman opening a glass jar, placing its lid on the counter, and dropping a piece of fruit into the jar before pressing it down. She then picks up another jar and shows its contents. Next, she scoops the flesh out of a melon with a spoon, cuts the melon in half and slices it with a knife, removing the seeds. She continues to chop cucumber and other visible fruit on a white cutting board, including strawberries, blueberries, orange pieces and lemon wedges. The cut pieces are placed into the open jars that are arranged on the granite countertop. The clip ends with her reaching for one of the filled jars with both hands.

action.detailed: Open the glass jars, cut cucumber, melon, strawberries, lemon and other fruits on the cutting board, scoop out and slice the melon, then place the cut pieces into the open jars, and finally grasp a filled jar.
action.actor: the woman standing at the kitchen counter

nodes.plm_action: Add a splash of citrus flavor.
nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows a woman preparing jars of fruit. She adds strawberries, lemons, basil, kiwi, and blackberries into the jars. She seals the jars in a water bath. And then places them in a fridge.
The background is a countertop with a white cutting board, and several other containers and fruit. There is a fridge in the background.

summary.brief: The woman fills mason jars with sliced strawberries, lemon, lime, basil and other fruits, adds water, seals the jars, and lines the finished jars on the countertop.
summary.detailed: She first places cut strawberries, a lemon slice and lime pieces into a clear mason jar and tops them with fresh basil leaves, then holds up the jar to show its contents. Next she sets cucumber slices on the cutting board, cuts cucumber, pineapple, plums, watermelon and more strawberries, and drops those pieces into separate jars. She puts a lid on each jar, removes the lids and places them on the work surface while pouring water from the nearby dispenser over the fruit, then replaces and tightens the lids. Finally she arranges all of the sealed, water‑filled jars in a line on the granite countertop.

action.detailed: Cut the fruit, place the pieces into each mason jar, pour water over them, screw the lids on tightly, and set the sealed jars on the countertop.
action.actor: The woman wearing a white shirt

nodes.plm_action: Store the jars in a cool, dark place.
nodes.plm_caption: It shows six clear glass jars filled with assorted fruits, a list of the contents shown over the bottom of the screen. The close up shot shows the jar contents. The background is a granite countertop with a window in the background. There is also text on the bottom of the screen.

summary.brief: Six clear glass jars of fruit‑infused water are displayed on a granite countertop with on‑screen labels of their ingredients.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a hand placing a silver lid on the first of several clear jars that already contain water, sliced fruit and herbs. The camera then pans across a row of six similar jars arranged on a brown‑granite countertop, each topped with a silver lid. A scrolling caption at the bottom of the frame lists the specific fruit‑herb combinations for each jar (e.g., cucumber‑pineapple‑mint, strawberry‑lemon‑basil, etc.). The view briefly zooms in, showing the colorful fruit pieces suspended in the clear liquid inside the jars while natural light from a window behind illuminates the scene. A hand reaches in from the left and lifts one of the jars, after which the camera pulls back to display the full row again. The segment ends with a close‑up of four of the jars, still on the granite surface, with another bottom‑of‑screen label describing their contents.

action.detailed: The presenter puts a silver jar lid onto the first glass jar, sealing the fruit‑filled water after the ingredients have been added.
action.actor: the presenter’s hand

nodes.plm_caption: There are six mason jars with different fruital ingredients inside and some liquid. The jars are side by side and sitting on a counter. In the next frame a white cutting board with some cut fruit and a red bowl sit next to the jars. There are three chairs behind the counter, and a table behind the chair. and a woman in a brown shirt and white pants in the background.

nodes.plm_action: Chop and prepare the added ingredients.
nodes.plm_caption:
The video features a women in a kitchen showing how to make a fruit salad and what ingredients are needed. She cuts the various fruits, throws them into a bowl, and then picks them up. The jars are full of solutions. The background is the kitchen, granite counter, a white paper towel to dry off the fruits, a white chopping board and a white napkin. The lighting is bright and the whole scene is in color.
The first 3 seconds of the video shows a bowl, then a woman's hands hold a watermelon on a white chopping board. The woman's hand move to the left to grab a knife and cut the watermelon. She picks up the knife with her right hand and cuts the watermelon into smaller pieces. She picks up the cut up watermelon pieces and puts them in a bowl. She picks up blackberries and places them in a bowl. She picks a piece of orange and the knife and cuts the orange slice. She places the piece of orange in a bowl, she then picks up an apple and cuts it and places it in a bowl. Finally, she throws the orange and apple to the left.

summary.brief: A woman chops assorted fruits, mixes them in a bowl, and displays the salad while jars of infused water remain in the background.
summary.detailed: The camera follows the woman's hands, which are wearing a watch on her left wrist, as she works at a white cutting board on a granite countertop. She first cuts a piece of watermelon into bite‑size cubes and drops them into a red bowl, then slices a half cantaloupe into cubes, adds blackberries and strawberries, and places each batch into the same bowl. Next she cuts an orange segment and an apple into pieces and adds them, shakes the bowl to mix the colorful fruit, and lifts it to show the contents. She then squeezes lemon juice over the fruit, holds the bowl up for the camera, and finally rolls a strawberry inside a white napkin. Throughout the segment, rows of glass jars filled with fruit‑infused water are visible on the counter, along with a paper towel and other kitchen utensils.

action.detailed: Using a chef’s knife, she slices watermelon, cantaloupe, orange, apple, strawberries and blackberries into bite‑size pieces, transfers each to a bowl, squeezes lemon juice over the mixture, shakes and displays the fruit, and rolls a strawberry in a napkin.
action.actor: the woman (hands visible, wearing a watch on her left wrist)

nodes.plm_caption:
A video that shows someone preparing and using a set of jars. The video also shows the person using the jars with a container of food, such as berries, in it.
The first shot shows the inside of a kitchen sink, with a few splashes of water, a knife, and a cutting board. The person's hand holds a clear jar and pours water from a faucet onto it. Then the hand puts the cutting board inside a dish washer and pushes it back and forth. Then the hand points at the bottom of a black machine.

The final shot is a closeup of a bowl of mixed berries sitting in a row on a counter, with six mason jars with fruit next to the bowl.

The next shot shows a refrigerator open with a row of six mason jars filled with fruit next to one another and the bottom shelf with more jars. There is a text that states: "Place in fridge to keep cool."

summary.brief: The presenter rinses a cutting board and knife, loads them into the dishwasher, and then displays the finished fruit‑infused water jars in the refrigerator.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a hand holding a clear jar and pouring water from the faucet onto it, then placing a white cutting board and a black‑handled knife into a stainless‑steel sink where running water rinses away food residue. The board and knife are lifted and positioned on the middle rack of a black dishwasher, the door is closed and a button on the control panel is pressed to start the wash cycle. The view then shifts to a close‑up of a bowl of mixed berries on a granite countertop beside six mason jars filled with sliced fruit, and finally to an open refrigerator where the same jars are arranged on a shelf, with on‑screen text reminding viewers to keep them cool.

action.brief: Load utensils into dishwasher and display jars in fridge
action.detailed: Rinse the cutting board and knife under running water, place them on the middle rack of the dishwasher, close the door and start the cycle, then arrange the prepared fruit‑infused water jars on a refrigerator shelf.
action.actor: the presenter, a woman shown throughout the video

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a collection of six mason jars standing side by side on a kitchen counter. A text that reads "Fruit Infused Water" appears in the center of the image. The bottom edge of the shot contains text which reads: "Fruit Infused Water" on the left and "Water" and "Fruit Infused" on the right, both in red color. The jars are all filled with a variety of fruit including watermelon, lemons, limes, strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, and pineapple. The jars are clear and are on a granite surface. All the jars have silver lids.

nodes.plm_action: Gather and prepare the fruits and vegetables.
nodes.plm_caption: The video features an array of different fruits on a counter. The video starts with five jars full of water and fruit. On the counter there are seven other different types of fruit and four packs of water. There are also nine empty jars stacked on top of each other and a white cutting board and a melon as well. The video ends with the word "Mrs Naturally E3 Halo" in red letters at the bottom right corner of the screen.
